receipts.semantics: File fsync, exclusive hard-link publication, directory fsync; existing receipt always refuses replay. SIGKILL at file-synced/published/directory-synced leaves absent or full final bytes. Temporary crash residue retained, not silently deleted.
receipts.limitations: Not a power-loss/filesystem-failure proof. Errors after publication can leave a full final file with uncertain directory durability; no retry implied.

supervisor.limitations: Proves survival after launching command returned, not WSL reboot or a future chat interruption. RemainAfterExit preserves manager evidence, not process liveness.

D65.product_frontier: Durable privately supervised availability campaign before ranked quality study
D65.operational_residue: No automatic retry/resume after reboot; publication/deployment deferred

claim_ceiling: Operational preflight, not benchmark quality or superiority
open_questions: Does the real multi-case campaign stay live across actual chat-turn boundaries?
Can exact-ID runtime evidence improve matched reader accuracy after full all-in costs?
